_comment: Two Security API payloads for a least-privilege solr-mcp user. Send as admin via scripts/solr-api.sh. Replace <password> by reading it from the Secret created first (see runbooks/bootstrap.md step 4); never paste it into chat. Permission names are Solr's predefined permissions.
_note: set-permission on an existing named permission replaces its role list; the lists above keep the operator's default roles and add solr-mcp. Verify the bootstrapped security.json (kubectl exec … curl admin/authorization) before applying so you do not drop a role the operator relies on.
